title: Six-week doped-film project
subtitle: RbNi2Se2 with Ti and Mn dopants: two interleaved sub-projects, eight strained films, one report
budget_label: Standard budget: 400 lab actions, every hand-over by t = 1368 h
task: Host RbNi2Se2 (ThCr2Si2 structure), doped with Ti and with Mn. For each dopant: synthesize a single-phase pellet of the distorted phase at a target ordering temperature (Ti 161.9 ± 3 K, Mn 188.0 ± 3 K), refine its two-phase structure, measure its optical gap and find the DFT+U U that reproduces it, then grow and verify strained films. Finish with film magnetism and Hall transport across strains and a report workbook with live formulas. One budget of 400 lab actions, a simulated clock with shared instruments, and a fixed deadline of 1368 simulated hours.

outcome.headline: All 46 graded checks pass; the last hand-over lands at t = 1091.2 h, 80% of the deadline

items.name: Ti-doped pellet: synthesis and two-phase structure
items.note: 7/7 checks pass: single-phase distorted pellet at the target ordering temperature; composition, cell, anion position, minor phase, texture; pilot pellet diagnosed

items.name: Ti: optical gap, DFT+U and band structure
items.note: 4/4 checks pass: mean optical gap; U that DFT+U reproduces; ground state; k-convergence; band extrema

items.name: Mn-doped pellet: synthesis and two-phase structure
items.note: 7/7 checks pass: single-phase distorted pellet at the target ordering temperature; composition, cell, anion position, minor phase, texture; pilot pellet diagnosed

items.name: Ti: strained films (specular + in-plane)
items.note: 8/8 checks pass: strain prediction committed before growth; device film verified by specular and in-plane scans; gap of a second film predicted before its optics

items.name: Mn: optical gap, DFT+U and band structure
items.note: 5/5 checks pass: mean optical gap; U that DFT+U reproduces; ground state; k-convergence; band extrema; gap predicted from the Ti U before any measurement

items.name: Mn: strained films (specular + in-plane)
items.note: 8/8 checks pass: strain prediction committed before growth; device film verified by specular and in-plane scans; gap of a second film predicted before its optics

items.name: Film magnetism and transport, both dopants
items.note: 4/4 checks pass: ordering temperature of ≥ 2 films per dopant, T_N–strain slope, carrier type and density

items.name: Report workbook with live formulas
items.note: 3/3 checks pass: workbook schema, live formulas, values consistent with the cited measurements
